item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 22/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An anticyclone aloft will bring persistently very hot and generally fine weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. Tropical Cyclone Doksuri is expected to move towards the seas east of Luzon in the next few days and intensify gradually. It will then move across the northeastern part of the South China Sea. Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be persistently very hot over southern China early to midweek next week. The subsequent movement of Doksuri remains uncertain. It may edge closer to the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of next week, or move towards the vicinity of Taiwan instead.
